# Vendored: @react-cards-opening/effects

The framework-free part of https://github.com/BetterTyped/react-cards-opening (packages/effects/src), MIT
(LICENSE.md), at commit 817882c57f618b03be17ee4d47c00e44c9180795 (2026-10-12). The React wrapper
(effect-layer.tsx) is left out: `playEffects(layer, names, options)` works on any element with the class
`rco-fx-layer`. Needs GSAP, which the site already has. Unchanged apart from leaving files out; used only by the
Grist effects playground for now.
